evidence.title: Creation tx of ArcRewardsVault v2 (0x7d49…dabd), block 19984396

results.why: Earliest of the entry's README-listed contracts: ArcRewardsVault v2 0x7d49f880c7bdae4fd44d52c3dbfb43534e83dabd created in block 19984396 at 2026-09-09T14:48:36Z (tx 0x5e56…74c4, deployer 0x408c…6fe8). explorer.arc.io/arcscan were behind a Cloudflare challenge, so block/timestamp/tx were read from rpc.mainnet.arc.io (chainId 5042; eth_getCode binary search + block timestamp + receipt). Next ones: ArcPad v3.1 2026-09-11, ArcAggregator v3 2026-09-13. Pre-dates public mainnet (private window); GitHub repo created 2026-09-10. Current 2026-10-10 value is the index date and should be replaced. Treasury 0xb35c…c0d has no code (EOA/Safe not deployed), skipped.

evidence.title: mercuri-launch-contracts README: Arc Mainnet deployment v1.0.0

results.why: README deployment record: Arc Mainnet (chain 5042) v1.0.0 deployed 21 September 2026 at block 22,060,881. RPC confirms LaunchFactory 0x8f5d…59eb code from block 22060930 (2026-09-21T20:01:30Z) and Timelock 0x94af…eb40 from 2026-09-21T20:01:15Z. Matches current value.
results.category_why: Current 'launchpads' is right. Site: Mercurifi is "a token launchpad, a trading venue and a board of lending vaults on Arc." Launch is the lead product; Trade (Uniswap v4 pools, not its own AMM) supports a secondary 'dexs'/trading tag.

evidence.title: SolonPad changelog: V3, the stock-dividend launchpad

results.why: Changelog 2026-10-03: "V3 went live on Arc mainnet: every coin's trade fee buys real tokenized stock for its holders..." (earliest entry). UNCERTAIN: the SOLON token 0xd366…d1a0 has code from block 21153877 (2026-09-16T12:00:13Z, created inside tx 0x1a43420b1594cd238093ef3775ccbfe109394a4302fdcc62274d2bc47bfa7da0 to factory 0x0000ffffbe8efe702c8703ae3477ff5de3d319c0, owner unknown), so an earlier SolonPad version or another pad may have launched it; changelog documents nothing before V3.
results.category_why: Current 'launchpads' is right. Docs: "SolonPad is a token launch platform on Arc." SolonLend (Morpho vault, created 2026-10-08) supports the secondary 'lending' tag.
